independent_execution.real_cohort_reconstruction: Reconstructed 4,965 TRAIN and 1,219 validation windows and exactly reproduced the frozen split, cohort, standard validation-row and full context/input digests.
independent_execution.hugging_face_snapshot: Verified the exact local four-file snapshot and each configured SHA-256; hf cache verification passed for the pinned revision.
independent_execution.official_api_review: Inspected the official Amazon Chronos v2.3.2 pipeline source. It accepts batch-by-variate-by-history arrays, native NaN missingness, cross_learning=False and returns per-input variate-by-horizon-by-quantile tensors matching the runner extraction.

approved_contract: One frozen zero-shot inference pass over exactly the reviewed 1,219 validation issuance rows; no fitting, fine-tuning or parameter update is permitted.

Each issuance supplies the prior 24 source intervals for four frequency channels. Missing non-38-kHz channel values remain NaN for the official observation mask, while the required 38-kHz history is fully observed.
Cross-learning across issuance rows is disabled. The runner extracts the 38-kHz outputs at source-interval steps 1, 3 and 6 and the fixed five protocol quantiles.
Inference shards, final assembly and restart state are bound to full model inputs, masks, times, provenance, exact canonical batch order and all source/model/config/review hashes.
Cumulative inference time, process-tree RSS and peak GPU reserved memory persist across restarts and enforce the frozen two-hour, 22-GiB and 10-GiB limits.
The output remains explicitly post-hoc TRAIN/validation development with SOTA claim NOT_ESTABLISHED.
execution_conditions: Run only after the currently active forward training process releases the single GPU owner lock or use the explicit CPU path without concurrent fitting.
Use chronos-forecasting 2.3.2 and the exact locally verified model snapshot; no network fallback, alternative revision or paid resource is approved.
Preserve the fixed validation row/context digests and corrected eligible-day evaluator; any code, config, source, split, cohort, model or review hash change invalidates this approval.
Obtain an independent post-run shard, prediction, metric and resource audit before using the result in development selection.
scientific_limits: This candidate was introduced after core development evidence and is post-hoc, not a preregistered confirmatory arm.
A result on the single AEON validation cohort cannot establish state of the art, external validity, calibrated absolute backscatter, biological causality or production value.
The four channels are treated as native multivariate targets. This is a fixed model-input choice, not evidence that the channels are interchangeable or causally related.
